rationale: The target candidate hyp-32a63ad13f743388bf95b6fc388791fe4b2369f6ac15c6a4124f9cf3b94a479d (backend_resource_saturation) and its only competitor hyp-db862d36010be73e9256ee258159be14ee36d57dbfce08fba5b0982e7b0bc1fd (postgres_slow_query) both target backend and rest on the same single supporting record, incident_1003-E-003, where backend logged 'Request processing exceeded deadline' at 2026-10-01T12:00:14Z; cause_discriminator_ids is empty for both and candidate_assessments reports the same unresolved questions, an unresolved competitor, and no verifier acceptance. The only other records, incident_1003-E-002 (gateway 'Request completed with HTTP 200' at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z) and incident_1003-E-001 (backend request_latency_ms=40 ms at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z), are a distinct-service log entry and a single low window-start metric that neither supply a second independent source nor discriminate either mechanism. Every candidate-discriminating source has now been successfully and completely queried and returned empty: query_changes unbounded (task-0002, 0 records, completed, covering the entire supplied pack); backend query_metrics with an empty metric_names list (task-0003, returning only incident_1003-E-001, completed with no continuation cursor, so the whole backend metric scope is exhausted); postgres get_db_slow_queries, get_db_lock_waits, get_db_connections, get_db_health_metrics and get_db_active_sessions (tasks 0004, 0005 and 0006, all 0 records, completed); and payment-scoped query_logs (task-0007, 0 records, completed). These empty results are persisting causal evidence gaps and not proof of health, but because the backend metric scope and every postgres scope that could discriminate the two candidates are already exhausted, a further named-metric or database query would only re-request the same empty scope, so no new discriminating scope is available and no genuine blocking requested_check can be raised. redis is the only listed service never queried but it is not a discriminator for either backend-focused candidate, so it is offered as nonblocking corroboration only; asking for it as a blocker would manufacture an objection beyond the observed evidence. Because a sufficient verdict requires empty requested_checks and contradictions, and the candidate still carries the E-002/E-003 mismatch and no observed cause-specific discriminator, the verdict is insufficient and the review abstains.
